text: 4:30 PM. Her station. She takes your hand. 'Now we go to MY home. On MY train.'
The station is full. Everyone is going home.
She buys a plum drink. Sour. 'Like the one you picked. I remember.'
NANDA: Hey, you. Wavy hair. And you. Hat boy, the gringo. Stop pushing. He is MINE.
She taps her card. Beep. Then she taps it again. For you. 'I pay. You are my guest.'
NANDA: Three fingers. Three times today. Same train. Same you.
5:20 PM. It's raining. She lays her head on yours. She drifts away.
Stop 12. Her stop. She wakes up fast. She pulls your sleeve. 'Home. Come.'
